role_rules.channel: the series colour (mind.the.gap coral, follow.the.money butter, under.the.hood lilac) marks channel identity only: pill, mark shadow, caption shadow. Never a country, a warning or a failure.
role_rules.answer: mint marks the answer, the brand and the next action only
role_rules.type_on_colour: type on a colour block is always ink

accent_kit.ruled: Krish approved on 2026-11-20 (the polish board): ember, ember_deep, plum, plum_deep and peach join the brand kit, scoped to big moments, gradients and duotone cut-outs on Monday, Wednesday and Friday only; off days are unchanged (mint, never coral).

roles.big_moment: the ground and the number of a full-frame moment: plum Anton on the moment gradient, at most 2 s, at most once a cut
roles.gradient: the moment gradient and the title variant below, nothing else
roles.duotone_cutout: a person or object cut out of a story's photo, its luminance mapped through duotone_ember; never his face in a cut (subject-lift owns that)

accent_kit.off_days: unchanged: mint and the house tones, never an accent colour (config/brand-palette.json colour.off)

gradients.moment_glow: a 35% peach radial at the number's height, and grain 0.09
